### Bio:

Hello everyone! 
I am interested in statistical machine learning, interpretable AI, and algorithm designing. My research experience includes time-series forecasting, UAV anomaly detection, and image-based nutrition estimation. During my algorithm internship at Cardinal Operations, I developed predictive models and improved the accuracy and efficiency of forecasting pipelines. I enjoy building reliable models and designing rigorous evaluations, and I am excited to apply these skills to problems in healthcare.
Beyond that, I do like movies, hiking, traveling, and photographing. Feel free to contact me :)
